title: Jagged Smoky Chinese Tofu Noodles
description: A smoky and light Chinese dish featuring garlic granules and kneaded noodles, perfect for midnight cravings, this jain-friendly recipe is a delight to the taste buds.
instructions: Knead the noodles according to the package instructions until they are pliable and easy to work with.
Cut the tofu into small jagged pieces and set aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the tofu to the wok and cook until it is golden brown and crispy.
Add the garlic granules, smoked paprika, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper to the wok and stir to combine.
Add the noodles to the wok and stir to combine with the tofu and sauce.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter and garnish with chopped scallions.
